event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Batam Anchorage, Indonesia Indonesia 01° 10.52' N 103° 56.59' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2023
sources.text: While at anchor, the ship crew sighted three perpetrators armed with knives at the engine room. The crew raised the alarm and informed the duty officer. All crew mustered, and a search on board was conducted by the crew with no perpetrators found.
